item.desc: Rongjiang County has just been lifted out of poverty and is a small county town on the 18th line. Rongjiang has a mild climate and abundant rainfall. mountain area. In the past few days, Rongjiang County in Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province, which has been hit by the nationwide outbreak of "village floods", has suffered a once-in-a-decade catastrophic flood disaster. The officers and soldiers of the stationed troops in Guizhou, as well as the militia, rushed to the scene to carry out rescue operations upon hearing the order. The Rongjiang County Fire and Rescue Brigade participated in the rescue overnight, actively transferring and evacuating the distressed people through boats, ropes and other equipment in the main streets of the county At 17:00 on June 28, the Guizhou Meteorological Station announced that the heavy rainfall had weakened significantly, and the blue warning of rainstorm was lifted. It is expected that the rainfall in the Duliujiang River Basin will significantly decrease in the future, but secondary disasters still need to be prevented. ------------- Rongjiang County is under the jurisdiction of Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture in Guizhou Province. Located in the southeastern part of Guizhou Province, in the southern part of Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture. It borders Liping County and Congjiang County to the east, Leishan County and Sandu Shui Autonomous County to the west, Jianhe County to the north, and Libo County to the south, with a total area of 3316 square kilometers and a total population of 385000. It is a multi-ethnic mixed population county, with ethnic minorities accounting for 81% of the total population and a total of 16 ethnic groups. #Guizhou#Rongjiang#flood #cn #top #china #hot #pla #soldier
